objective:
Goal: a form to create a new API key or token is visible. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "Click Settings → API Keys and press Create key.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, store the main heading of the page you end on as 'landed_on', then verify the goal on screen.
